He is the youngest son of Lord Phenex and Lady Phenex, the younger brother of Ruval Phenex and an unnamed older brother, and the older brother of Ravel Phenex. He was the main antagonist of Volume 2 of the novels. He was once Rias Gremory’s fiancé who has inherited the powers of the immortal bird, Phoenix, granting him immortality and instant regeneration. His all-female peerage consists of fourteen members. Riser is a tall and handsome young man in his early 20's with short blond hair and dark blue eyes.

His outfit consists of a burgundy blazer with gold embroidery on the right with matching pants and black dress shoes. Underneath his open blazer is a white dress shirt that is not fully buttoned (just one button short), giving a slight view to his chest.
Personality

During his introductory volume, Riser is shown to be an arrogant, aggressive playboy with a holier-than-thou personality, tongue-kissing two of his girls just to agitate Issei and making improper advances on Rias. Kiba pointed out that Riser has no qualms in "sacrificing" his peerage members during Rating Games if it meant winning against opponents, being something he favors, taking advantage of the fact that he has a full set.

He is also condescending towards lower-class Devils, mocking Issei on his improper use of the Boosted Gear after the latter was defeated by Mira in one blow and labeling him as a weakling. Despite this, Riser does show an honorable side, as he allows Rias and her peerage ten days to prepare themselves for their Rating Game, knowing he would simply crush her and her peerage had she not accepted. Like most devils, Riser has no good opinion about humans or the Human World, in general, previously mentioning that he hated the wind and fires of the Human World.

Later, after his defeat by the hands of Issei, Riser fell into a slump following his defeat, not moving out of his house after the loss. It is also explained that Riser developed a fear of Dragons as a result of losing to Issei, and he became traumatized, upon seeing Issei and Dragons he would quake in fear. Riser is also shown to be a pervert, not only purposely creating an all female peerage, but also his desire to see Rias and Akeno's breast partially being what brings him out of his slump. After recovering from his trauma, Riser seems to have reformed from his old ways, showing a degree of respect for his former combatants, especially Issei. For example, in Volume 10, he gives Rias advice on Rating Games prior to her match against Sairaorg, and in Volume 12, he gives his condolences to Ravel and Rias after Issei's supposed death.

In the Extra Life of DX.1, during their rematch seeing how Rias' Peerage easily defeated his, instead of being enraged and insulting everyone, he humbly accepted the result. He began to show interest in fighting strong foes, especially Issei, despite the clear difference in power. Riser states that he does not mind losing, saying instead that he will use it a stepping stone to get stronger which is another sign of his maturity. Riser is the third (and youngest) son of the Phenex family and the second-youngest sibling in the family, behind his sister Ravel. At some point before the start of the series, his family set up an arranged marriage between him and Rias (with her family's approval, as well) in an attempt to unite the two families and to preserve the bloodline of Pure-Blooded Devils.
Powers & Abilities

Demonic Power: As a Devil, Riser has all the common skills and powers of one, including the power to cast spells. It is shown Riser can teleport himself to any location. In the LN, Riser was stated to possess a rainbow-colored demonic aura. In DX.1, his demonic power increases after training and manages to fight against Issei in Balance Breaker evenly, managing to put up a fight against his Crimson Armor despite being overwhelmed by its power initially. Hell flame and immortality

entries.name: Diodora Astaroth
entries.content:
Diodora Astaroth was the former heir of the Astaroth Clan. He was the son of Lord and Lady Astaroth. He was a gentle-looking, handsome young man with blond hair as depicted in the novel (dark green hair in the anime). Diodora also had a big deep scar on his chest from when he injured himself to have Asia heal it as part of his plan to make her a heretic. He usually wears expensive clothing. He also has golden eyes, but they are almost always closed or squint Ed.

Age 19

Personality

While initially appearing to be a gentle, well-mannered, and charismatic young man, Diodora was in fact a narcissistic, sinister, vile, callous, and wicked person who would do "whatever it takes" to achieve his desires. He had an utter obsession with nuns and holy-maidens, which was exemplified by the fact that all of his servants were once nuns and maidens that he had acquired after "breaking" them. He enjoyed seeing them with expressions of pain, sadness, and despair which he found to be an ultimate form of entertainment. This showed Diodora to be an incredibly sadistic Devil.

He was also very imprudent, as was exemplified when he used the Ophis' power in a careless way despite Shalba Beelzebub forbidding him from doing so, as it allowed the Three Factions higher-ups such as Sirzechs and Azazel to catch wind of the Khaos Brigade's plot due to noticing his irregular increase in power. Despite this, he is very intelligent, deceptive, and manipulative, capable of manipulating others into doing his bidding. An example would be how he managed to convince the nuns and holy-maidens who would become his servants that he was in love with them, only to use them for his own twisted pleasure, showing that he is also incapable of love.

He was shown to have a loathing towards Dragons and those connected to them: he once called Issei a "filthy dragon". After being overpowered and defeated by Issei thus breaking his will to fight, he became immensely fearful of him and dragons as well. Demonic Power: Diodora showed some skill in using his demonic powers, as he was able to hurl conjured blades at Issei and create barriers during their fight. His power was greatly enhanced with Ophis' snake, surpassing Rias Gremory's demonic power and allowing him to completely overwhelm Seekvaira Agares, another High-Class Devil, with ease.

Magic: Diodora showed some skill in using magic.

Defensive Magic: Diodora demonstrated the ability to create a defensive magic circle to shield himself against attacks. He also demonstrated the ability to create a large barrier to trap Issei in order to stop his attacks.
Teleportation Magic: Diodora has demonstrated the ability to teleport himself and others.
Hypnosis Magic: In the anime, he used a form of hypnotism on his peerage to suppress their shame and embarrassment to fight against Issei's Dress Break spell.
Equipment

Ophis' Snake: After joining forces with the Khaos Brigade, he obtained a snake which he used to increase his power. He used it during his Rating Game against Seekvaira Agares and his fight with Issei Hyoudou. He lost the snake during his confrontation with Issei Hyoudou.

entries.name: Misla Bael
entries.content:
Misla Bael (née Vapula) is the mother of Sairaorg Bael, the first wife of Lord Bael, and a former member of the House of Vapula, a family of lion tamers and one of the remaining families of the 72 Pillars. Misla is a beautiful young woman who has long brown hair and purple eyes.

Age 32
Personality

Misla is a very kind and caring mother, loving her son over herself as shown when she opted to stay with her son, Sairaorg, despite the harsh treatment she received from her husband's family. Misla is also shown to be a wise mother, advising her son to become stronger in different ways to overcome his lack of talent. Despite the horrible discrimination she suffered from the Bael Clan including her husband, Misla held absolutely no ill feelings such as anger or hatred towards her husband or the Bael Family as she told Sairaorg to take pride in his heritage as a Bael, despite the discrimination he had suffered, even blaming herself for birthing Sairaorg without letting her son inherit the Power of Destruction. Originally from the House of Vapula, Misla married into the House of Bael and eventually gave birth to Sairaorg. When the Bael Clan discovered that Sairaorg did not inherit the Bael's Power of Destruction, Misla and her son were treated badly, even by her own husband. This eventually resulted in her being sent to the countryside of the Bael territory along with her son. She later went into a coma, which Misla's butler says is a common disease faced by Devils in which they would remain comatose and eventually die. Before her coma, she made Sairaorg promise her that he would become stronger than anyone else.

entries.name: Beluga
entries.content:
Beluga Furcas is Sairaorg's Knight from the House of Furcas, a family that tames horses and one of the remaining families of the 72 Pillars. Beluga has the appearance of a handsome young man with brown hair and green eyes. In battle, he wears medieval armor whilst riding upon Altobrau who was emits blue-white flames, which gives him the appearance of a medieval Knight.

Age 24

Personality

Beluga is fiercely loyal to Sairaorg. Like Yuuto Kiba and Karlamine, he also follows the pride and honor of a Knight.
History

Not much is known about Beluga's history, other than at some point before the series he joined Sairaorg's peerage.

Powers & Abilities

Demonic Power: As a Devil, Beluga has all the common skills and powers of one. Enhanced Speed: As a Knight, Beluga possesses enhanced speed and mobility. While riding on Altobrau, Beruka moves at an incredibly high speeds, comparable to that of Yuuto Kiba; who has god-like speed. Replication: Beluga has also shown to have the ability to create many duplicates of himself and his horse which have the same presence and enhanced speed as the real Beruka.

Horse Tamer: As a member of the Furcas clan, Beluga has the ability to tame horses. He tamed and rides a Pale Horse named Altobrau (アルトブラウ, Arutoburau).

Master Spearman: Beluga is a highly skilled lancer, which he combined with horsemanship on Altobrau. He could fight on par with Yuuto Kiba in a clash of weapons.

Flight: Being a Devil, Beluga can use his wings to fly.

entries.name: Coriana
entries.content:
Coriana Andrealphus is Sairaorg's Bishop from the House of Andrealphus, one of the extinct families from the 72 Pillars, which held the rank of Marquis. Coriana is an attractive and curvy young woman with long, wavy blonde hair and red eyes. She wears a red business suit with purple accents, and purple underwear underneath it.
Personality

Age 19

Coriana is loyal to Sairaorg, much like the rest of his peerage, as she willingly used her body and stripped in front of Issei Hyoudou during their Rating Game in order for her team to win.
History

Not much is known about Coriana, other than at some point before the series she joined Sairaorg's peerage. However, she was likely shunned by the other Devils given her mixed heritage.

Powers & Abilities

Demonic Power: As a Devil, Coriana has all the powers and skills afforded to one such as being able to cast spells and cause pheneoma. It was noted that she excels in all categories of demonic powers, but she's more of a support-type.

Enhanced Magic Power: As a Bishop, she can strengthen her magic and demonic powers.

Magic Talent: Befitting a Bishop, Coriana has various skills in magic and demonic powers, excelling in almost all categories.

Ice Magic: She can release spear-like projectiles created from ice using her demonic powers during her battle against Issei.
Flight: Being a Devil, Coriana can use her wings to fly.

entries.name: Misteeta Sabnock
entries.content:
Misteeta Sabnock is Sairaorg's Bishop from the House of Sabnock, one of the extinct families from the 72 Pillars, which held the rank of Marquis.

Age 18

Misteeta has the appearance of a young boy with light green hair and violet eyes, with two identical hair ornaments; one on each side.
Personality

Misteeta is extremely loyal to Sairaorg like the rest of the members of their master's peerage.
History

Misteeta Sabnock was shunned by the other Devils, being a descendant of an extinct household from the 72 Pillars with human heritage. He was accepted only by Sairaorg who took Misteeta in as a member of his peerage. As a result, he is very loyal to Sairaorg.

Powers & Abilities

Demonic Power: Misteeta has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the power to cast spells.

Enhanced Magic Power: As a Bishop, he can strengthen his magic and demonic powers.

entries.name: Gandoma Balam
entries.content:
Gandoma Balam is Sairaorg's Rook from the House of Balam, one of the remaining families from the 72 Pillars. The trait of this household is having superhuman strength. Gandoma is an enormous man who is about 3 meters (around nine feet) tall. He has a muscular build and his arms and fingers are thick in size. His face resembles that of a monster rather than a human with his skin being tan in color. His eyes are pale blue-gray.

Age 30
Personality

Gandoma is extremely loyal to Sairorg like all of the members of Sairorg's peerage.
History

Not much is known about Gandoma, other than at some point before the series, he joined Sairaorg's peerage.

Powers & Abilities

Demonic Power: As a Devil, Gandoma has all the common skills and powers of one. Immense Strength: As a member of the Balam Clan, Gandoma has natural superhuman strength, which was further increased through physical augmentation of a Rook Piece and further training, being able to defeat Koneko with a single strike even when he himself was on the verge of retirement.

Immense Durability: As a Rook and a member of the Balam clan, Gandoma has incredible defense and durability, which has allowed him to withstand powerful physical attacks from Koneko Toujou in her Nekomata Mode Level 2 and even Rossweisse's Norse magic. Even after taking a full burst magic attack from Rossweisse while his aura was disrupted by Koneko, he managed to muster enough strength to take down Koneko.

Magic Resistance: He has a very high resistance to magic attacks, even those from Rossweisse's powerful offensive magic, requiring Koneko to disrupt his aura with Senjutsu enhanced attacks for Rossweisse's magic to take full effect.
Flight: Being a Devil, Gandoma can use his wings to fly.
Equipment

Rook Piece (戦車の駒, Sensha no koma): Gandoma was given the Rook Piece, which grants him enhanced offense and defense.

entries.name: Tannin
entries.content:
Age 1000 Tannin is a purple Dragon and a former Dragon King, also known as the Blaze Meteor Dragon. He was reincarnated by Mephisto Pheles, becoming an Ultimate-Class Devil and helped train Issei in order to help him attain his Balance Breaker. Tannin has the appearance of a fifteen meter tall, gigantic western Dragon. With the exception of his lower body, specifically his belly, the inner portions of his long tail and legs, that are beige in color, a majority of Tannin's body is covered in dark purple scales. Tannin also has a triangular head with yellow horns, a pair of large, keen red eyes with lavender sclera, and serrated yet sharp canine teeth. He also has claws with long sharp, yellow nails, on his hands, and large bat-like wings with rigid tips.

Age 1000+

In the anime, he possesses a distinctly humanoid form & wears black armored pauldrons that extend down to his arms and a loincloth decorated with metallic accessories.

In his mini-Dragon form, he is similar in size to Asia Argento's Dragon familiar, Rassei.
Personality

Tannin has a warrior-like personality and dislikes those who are lazy. Unlike other Dragons that are generally selfish, Tannin cares a lot for his fellow Dragons; willing to become a Devil both in order for his race to continue and to take care of his people in the Dragon mountain. Standing tall with a pride befitting a true Dragon, Issei sees Tannin suitable, true and worthy of his calling as a true Dragon King in every way possible, despite the latter being reincarnated as an Ultimate-Class Devil.
History

Tannin, one of the five Dragon Kings, once challenged Great Red to a fight, but was ignored by him. Sometime before the series, he was reincarnated into a Devil by Mephisto Pheles. He became a Devil for two reasons: the first was to participate in the Rating Games, the second was for the Dragon Apples, a fruit that now exists only in the Underworld, which a certain race of Dragons needs to eat in order to survive.

He then joined the Rating Games, becoming one of the Top 10 and became an Ultimate-Class Devil where he gained the right to receive his own territory and chose the area where the Dragon Apples grew. He even started conducting research on how to artificially grow the Dragon Apples. Sometime before the series, Tannin entered into a semi-retired state from the Rating Games so that he could train the younger generation of Dragons.
Powers & Abilities

Demonic Power: Tannin has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the power to cast spells.

Enhanced Magic Power: Due to the Bishop trait of his Queen Piece, Tannin can strengthen his magic and demonic powers.

Immense Strength: As both a former Dragon King and an Ultimate-Class Devil himself, Tannin is extremely powerful, with his strength touted as on par with even the Four Great Satans.

Enhanced Speed: Due to the Knight trait of his Queen piece, Tannin has increased speed and mobility. Against Bikou, despite his gigantic size, he can be rather agile, avoiding the Monkey Youkai's attacks.

Immense Durability: Tannin has considerable defenses as a Dragon, which is further enhanced through the Rook trait, withstanding multiple attacks from the Gremory Group ranging from Kiba's Sword Birth, Xenovia's Durandal, Koneko's punch, Akeno's lightning attacks, and Issei's Dragon Shot with little to no damage at all.[1] Before Issei properly attained his Balance Breaker, his punches dealt no damage to Tannin's scales, and even injured himself. And fire breath.

entries.name: Viser
entries.content:
Viser was a Stray Devil whom Rias and her peerage confronted.

Age 100+

Viser was a young woman with a voluptuous figure with short white hair but her lower body was gigantic and beastly with four legs, each having sharp claws, and a snake as a tail. Her overall appearance was reminiscent to that of a Centaur.

In the anime, Viser still retained her voluptuous upper body, although her short white hair is replaced with long, black hair. Her centaur-like appearance has also been slightly altered, with her front legs featuring humanoid hands with red claws (the same color as her sharp nails) and her stomach featuring a cavity with teeth to devour her opponents. In the middle of her battle with the Occult Research Club, her face changed bearing piranha-like teeth, pointed ears, and black sclera in place of the usual white. 
Personality

Viser was a ruthless Devil who had an extreme lust for blood, evidenced through her introductory speech. In the anime, she shows some exhibitionist traits, rubbing her bare breasts in pleasure in front of her combatants. Not much was known about Viser, other than at some point she was likely reincarnated into a Devil, and left her master and started to consume human bodies for food.
Plot

The Red Dragon Emperor's Awakening

Viser was introduced in the Volume 1 of the light novels when Rias and Occult Research Club were ordered to dispose of her because of her actions. During the battle, she was incapacitated by Yuuto (cutting her arms off), Koneko (punching her in the stomach), and Akeno (electrocuting her with lightning). Overwhelmed by their power, she was soon confronted by Rias, whom she asks to kill her. Complying with her last words, Rias terminates her using her Power of Destruction.

Equipment

Spear: Viser wields two spears that appear to be strong enough to pierce the ground.

Enhanced Strength: Viser's monster-like lower body possessed superhuman strength, shown when she manages to briefly hold down Koneko.
Demonic Power: As a Stray Devil, Viser possesses demonic power. She also fights with two spear-like objects.
Breast Acid: In the anime, she has the ability to squirt acid from her breasts that can melt walls (with magic circles appearing on her nipples prior to firing), and has the ability to consume her opponents using her stomach cavity from her Centaur body

entries.name: Isabela
entries.content:
Isabela is a voluptuous woman with short, light brown hair and grey eyes. Her hair has three red highlights across, and wears a plain white mask which covers the right side of her face. Her outfit consists of a black jacket and matching jeans. The jacket has wide shoulders and a wide collar, and features three leather straps on both her arms. It is also slightly open, revealing her rather-large breasts and cleavage, and it is cut off at her midriff. Her jeans have a section (on her right pant leg) cut off, revealing some of her thighs and rear end, and also features three leather straps on her calves, just below the ankles, and two extra straps on her right pant leg to keep it in place. She also wears black fighting gloves and boots to enhance her blows.
Personality

Like the rest of the members of Riser's peerage, Isabela is loyal to Riser and will carry out the orders given by him. Unlike most of the other members, however, she has shown to be respectful and cordial to opponents that have defeated her such as Issei.
History

Not much is known about Isabela, other than at some point before the series, she was revived as a Devil by Riser.
Plot

The Red Dragon Emperor's Awakening

Isabela first appears in Volume 2 at the Occult Research Club, when Riser introduces his peerage to Rias after the two of them decide to have a Rating Game. During the Rating Game, Isabela fought against Issei, losing to the latter after Issei used Dress Break to strip off her clothes and blasts her with a (second) Dragon Shot.

Age 19

Demonic Power: As a Devil, Isabela has all the common skills and powers of one.

Enhanced Strength: Befitting a Rook, Isabela possesses high strength, her attacks were strong enough to push Issei back a bit, needing to boost his powers until he rivals a High-Class Devil to defeat her.

Enhanced Durability: As a Rook, Isabela has high defenses.

Enhanced Speed: Despite being a Rook, she is noted to be rather quick on her feet, often emplying footwork into her fighting style.

Expert Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Isabela is noted to be well-versed in a fighting style resembling Boxing, using punches and kicks, in addition to flicker jabs against Issei, who was barely managing against her.[1] In their rematch, she improved enough to where she could handle fighting against Issei donned in his Scale Mail.
Equipment

Anti-Magic Mask: For unknown reasons, Isabela wears a mask that covers the right side of her face, which has some kind of anti-magic spell added onto it, remaining intact despite Isabela being hit by Issei's Dress Break twice.

Rook Piece (戦車の駒, Sensha no koma): Isabela was reincarnated using the Rook Piece, which grants her enhanced offense and defense.

entries.name: Ile and Nel
entries.content:
Ile and Nel are two of Riser Phenex's Pawns. Ile and Nel are two very young girls with turquoise hair, which they keep tied to one side of their head with a yellow ribbon (opposite to their sister), and blue eyes. Both of their outfits consist of gym uniforms, which consist of white t-shirts with blue accents, black tight spats, and blue sneakers over knee-high socks, similar to the Kuoh Academy's girls' gym uniforms, albeit without the logo. They also wear an orange wristband on their left wrist. Both of their chainsaws are colored blue, but they carry them in different-colored gym bags when not in use (Ile carries a blue bag, while Nel carries a red bag)

Age both 13
Personality

Despite their innocent appearance, Ile and Nel are very dangerous and will cut down their opponents without a second thought, taking a playful amusement while chasing their target to do so. However the twins have demonstrated a habit of underestimating their opponents which in their fight with Issei resulted in their humiliating defeat
History

Not much is known about Ile and Nel, other than at some point before the series, they were revived as Devils by Riser Demonic Power: As a Devils, both girls have all the common skills and powers of one.

Fire: Ile and Nel can emit flames from their chainsaws

Equipment

Chainsaws: Ile and Nel's primary weapons[1].

Pawn Piece (兵士の駒ポーンのこま, Heishi no koma): Ile and Nel were reincarnated using a Pawn Piece, which initially doesn't grant any special abilities like the other Evil Pieces, but which possesses the ability to use Promotion to gain the abilities of other Evil Pieces.

Promotion: Being Pawns, Ile and Nel can use Promotion to temporarily gain the traits of a Queen, Rook, Knight or Bishop.

entries.name: Ni and Li
entries.content:
Ni and Li are two of Riser Phenex’s Pawns. Ni and Li are two young girls, appearing to be in their teens. Being twins they sport similar appearances, with the major difference being Ni's red eyes and blue hair, in contrast to Li's blue eyes and red hair. Also, Ni ties her hair in a ponytail, while Li has hers in a braid with a pink bow tied at the end. Due to them being Nekomatas before being reincarnated as Devils, both of them retained their trademark light brown cat ears with black stripes. They also wear piercings on their ears, with Li having two gold earrings on her left ear and Ni having blue colored ones on her right. Similarly, both of them have a fang sticking out of their mouths, with Ni having hers to her left, Li having hers on her right, thus mirroring each other. While they appear to be the same height in the anime, in the manga Ni appears a bit shorter than Li

Both age 19 

Both of them wear short skimpy, white sailor uniforms that reveal their abdomen, shoulders, and lower breasts, and wear short black skirts. They are also shown to tie their orange ascots in different ways respectively. Also, they're always seen wearing red and blue fighter's glove and leg guards matching their hair color respectively.
Personality

Both appear to be equally cheerful and appear to be childish even during a fight. They also show a feline personality, sometimes ending their sentences with a "Nya" (にゃ), mimicking a cat's meow.
History

Not much is known about Ni and Li, other than at some point before the series they joined Riser's Peerage after being possibly reincarnated by him. Demonic Power: As Devils, both girls have all the common skills and powers of one.

Ki Manipulation: While it is unclear to what extent, Koneko has noted that both Ni and Li are ki users just like herself.

Enhanced Strength: As Nekomatas, Ni and Li have natural high physical strength, and were strong enough to deal significant damage to both Issei's legs.

Heightened Senses: As Nekomatas, Ni and Li naturally have great senses such as smell and hearing. Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Together, the two are shown to be skilled in close quarters combat, which they use along with their incredible reflexes. They're also shown to be rather quick and agile.

Flight: As devils, they can fly using their wings.
Equipment

Pawn Piece (兵士の駒ポーンのこま, Heishi no koma): Ni and Li were reincarnated using a Pawn Piece, which initially doesn't grant any special abilities like the other Evil Pieces, but which possesses the ability to use Promotion to gain the abilities of other Evil Pieces.

Promotion: Being Pawns, Ni and Li can use Promotion to temporarily gain the traits of a Queen, Rook, Knight or Bishop.

entries.name: Karlamine
entries.content:
Karlamine is a young woman with light brown hair and green eyes. Her outfit consists of a full set of silver armor with black accents that appears to be a cross between a European Knight (her chest plate, gauntlets and greaves) and a Japanese Samurai (her hip plates and shoulder guards), and wears a headband that goes across her hair and forehead. She is equipped with a broadsword and a dagger, both of which are held with brown belts slung across her hip. The broadsword is slung on her left hip, and features a red jewel on the pommel and has bandages across the handle for grip. The dagger, which is located behind her hip, features a gold hilt with bandages on the handle.
Personality

A female warrior who follows the code of honor of a knight. She also comes off as a bold person, coming out in the open and demanding a proper challenge from her opponent. While she views those who come out directly up front in battle are idiots, she admits to have respect for them. According to Ravel, Karlamine is a "sword maniac", preferring to fight others in an intense sword match.

Karlamine also cares for her comrades, being unpleased at the fact that the Pawns in her group were being used as sacrificial pieces.

Demonic Power: As a Devil, Karlamine has all the common skills and powers of one.

Fire: Karlamine can produce powerful flames, which she coated around her sword and dagger during her fight against Kiba.
Wind: Karlamine can produce wind, which, in addition to her flames can create a powerful whirlwind that covers a wide area.
Enhanced Speed: As a Knight, Karlamine possesses superhuman speed, capable of rivaling that of Yuuto.

Master Swordswoman: Karlamine is heavily skilled in swordsmanship, being able to fight on par against Yuuto in terms of sword skills.
Equipment

Sword: Karlamine's main weapon, while it was destroyed during her initial battle with Yuuto, she eventually got a replacement.

Dagger: Karlamine's secondary weapon that appears like a dagger.

Knight Piece (騎士の駒, Kishi no koma): Karlamine was reincarnated using a Knight Piece, which enhances her speed, making her faster than an average person.

Age 17

entries.name: Misa
entries.content:
Mira is one of Riser Phenex's Pawns.  Mira is a young girl with blue hair and light brown eyes. Her hair is styled with six short ponytails, with four of the six. The front of her hair features split bangs going across her forehead, with side bangs framing her face.

Age 15

Her outfit consists of a white haori with a red obi, which is worn under a red happi coat. She wears bandages on her forearms and shins, and wears black guards over her hands. For footwear, she wears a pair of zōri.[2]
Personality

Like the other members, Mira is very loyal to Riser and will follow his orders without hesitation. She has been shown to be a very serious fighter, but has also demonstrated a habit of underestimating her opponents.

While initially having a bad impression of Issei for being a pervert, she later becomes a fan of his.
History

Not much is known about Mira, other than at some point before the series, she was revived as a Devil by Riser. Demonic Power: Mira has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the power to cast spells.

Enhanced Strength: Mira has shown that she possesses high strength despite her small size, being able to knock Issei out with ease.

Fire Magic: Mira has the ability to emit fire from her staff which is used to increase the destructive power of her attacks.

Bōjutsu: Mira is an expert combatant using Bōjutsu martial arts in tandem with a long wooden staff.
Equipment

Bō Staff: Mira's weapon of choice which she uses in combination with her martial arts.[3]

Pawn Piece (兵士の駒ポーンのこま, Heishi no koma): Mira was reincarnated using a Pawn Piece, which initially doesn't grant any special abilities like the other Evil Pieces, but which possesses the ability to use Promotion to gain the abilities of other Evil Pieces.

Promotion: Being a Pawn, Mira can use Promotion to temporarily gain the traits of a Queen, Rook, Knight or Bishop.

entries.name: Siris
entries.content:
Siris is one of Riser Phenex's Knights. Siris is a tall young woman with long black hair with a dark blue tint and brown eyes. Her hair features five thin ponytails going around her head, which are held up by a golden hair accessory on top of her head. Her outfit consists of a white top with black accents that is modeled after a Chinese cheongsam, red shorts, and armored, knee-high boots with matching gauntlets. The top features a diamond shape on the chest area, giving view of her breasts and cleavage.

Age 18

Siris is mostly seen with a giant Zweihänder that is mounted on her back when not in use. It features a black blade with silver edges, and has a black hilt with a red handle.
Personality

Despite being a Knight, Siris does not uphold a Knight's code of honor and is willing to follow the orders given to her without any doubt.
History

Not much was revealed about her past, only that at one point in time, she was revived as a Devil by Riser. Demonic Power: As a Devil, Siris has all the common skills and powers of one.

Enhanced Strength: Siris is also strong physically, being able to wield the huge weapon like Zweihänder with ease.

Shock Waves: Siris was able to create powerful gust of winds and shock waves with her attacks.
Enhanced Speed: As a Knight, Siris possesses increased speed and mobility.

Expert Swordswoman: Siris is skilled in swordsmanship. 

Zweihänder: A large two-handed sword that is Siris' primary weapon in battle.

Knight Piece (騎士の駒, Kishi no koma): Siris was reincarnated using a Knight Piece, which enhances her speed, making her faster than an average person.

entries.name: Xuelan
entries.content:
Xuelan is one of Riser Phenex's Rooks. Xuelan is a well-endowed young woman of Chinese descent with shoulder-length black hair and blue-green eyes. Her hair has two Chinese-style buns on both sides of her head, while the front features bangs that form a slight V-shape across her forehead.

Her outfit consists of a navy blue qipao with gold accents, a white sash around her stomach, and black, low-heeled shoes. The qipao is open at the chest area, giving view to Xuelan's breasts and cleavage. She also wears black armguards over her forearms. She does not wear any undergarments
Personality

Like the other members of Riser's peerage, Xuelan is loyal to Riser and carries out the orders given by him without question.
History

Not much is known about Xuelan, other than at some point before the series, she was reincarnated as a Devil by Riser as his Rook. Demonic Power: As a Devil, Xuelan has all the common skills and powers of one.

Fire: Xuelan can use her demonic powers to produce fire from her hands and feet, which strengthens her attacks.
Enhanced Strength: According to Koneko, her power as a Rook is on par with a Queen.

Enhanced Durability: As a Rook, Xuelan has enhanced durability.

Enhanced Speed: Despite being a Rook, Xuelan is noted to be capable of moving and attacking using high speed.

Expert Martial Artist: Xuelan is noted to be rather adept at using Kung Fu as her fighting style, making full use of punches and kicks.She improved her skills to the point of being capable of fighting against Koneko who started using her nekomata powers and ki for a time during their rematch.

Flight: As a Devil, Xuelan is capable of flight using her wings.

Age 17

entries.name: Yubelluna
entries.content:
Yubelluna is Riser Phenex's Queen and the strongest member of his peerage. She is also known as the Bomb Queen. Yubelluna is a voluptuous woman with long, wavy purple hair that falls all the way down her back and matching eyes. At the front, the right side of her hair falls over her breast and covers her right eye, while the left side falls near the top of her skirt.

Age 26

Her attire is a dress consisting of a navy blue tunic top with gold accents and a pale blue skirt with open sides, red high heeled shoes and over matching thigh-high stockings with garter belts. The top reveals much of her cleavage, and is held with a gold choker with blue and red jewels. Over this, she wears a white overcoat with black and gold accents and matching pauldrons. For accessories, she wears a black headband with a red-orange jewel over her forehead to keep her long hair in place, and wields a staff-like scepter in battle. For cosmetics, she wears purple lipstick and nail polish, matching her eyes and hair
Personality

Like the other members of Riser's peerage, Yubelluna is loyal to Riser and carries out the orders given by him without question. In combat, she is a cunning and confident tactician, not afraid to sneak attacks against opponents after they succeed in their goals, but is extremely submissive in Riser's presence.
History

Not much is revealed about her past, only that at one point in time, she was reincarnated as a Devil by Riser Demonic Power: As a reincarnated Devil, Yubelluna has all the common skills and powers of one. She was noted to be Riser's strongest servant, being able to defeat Koneko and Kiba, and fight on par with Akeno, albeit she wasn't using her true power. In Volume DX 1, Riser states she has gotten much stronger after training. She manages to hold her own in battle during her rematch against Akeno in her Fallen Angel Mode.

Explosive Demonic Power: Yubelluna can cause explosions using her demonic powers, appearing as if a bomb went off, thereby earning her epithet as the Bomb Queen. She can release them using her hands or staff,[3][4] with the resulting explosion being powerful enough to eliminate Koneko, a Rook, and Yuuto using one attack, albeit both of them were caught off guard.[3][5]
Enhanced Magic Power: From the Bishop trait of her Queen piece, she has enhanced magic power, which can strengthen her demonic powers and magic.

Enhanced Offense and Defense: From the Rook trait of her Queen Piece, Yubelluna has strength and durability enhancement, giving her enhanced strength and defense.

Enhanced Speed: From the Knight trait of her Queen piece, she has enhanced speed.

Magic Talent: Yubelluna is shown to be skilled in magic.

entries.name: Bülent
entries.content:
Bülent is one of Riser Phenex’s Pawns. Bülent is a young pretty girl with shoulder length brown hair and beautiful blue eyes, dressed in a sleeveless French maid uniform that exposes her cleavage, with a white laced design on the edges, as well as a maid headpiece, half-apron, and forearm length fingerless gloves.

Age 19

Personality

Bülent is loyal to Riser Phenex as well as affectionate towards him like the rest of his peerage. Bürent can be a bit complacent, falling for traps when believing to have achieved her objective. She also seems to be one who easily underestimates her opponents, as shown when she thought she had the upper hand on Yuuto for outnumbering him while blissfully unaware of his full capabilities. However she only shows this side of her in battle. In normal times, she is very friendly and kind towards everyone especially Lord Riser. She treats everyone fair and well and she really cares for their well being.
History

Nothing much is known about her past except that at one point she joined Riser's peerage.

Demonic Power: As a Devil, Bülent has all the common skills and powers of one. She was the Riser's strongest pawn.

Flight: Being a Devil, Bülent can use her wings to fly.
Equipment

Pawn Piece (兵士の駒ポーンのこま, Heishi no koma): Bülent was reincarnated using a Pawn Piece, which initially doesn't grant any special abilities like the other Evil Pieces, but which possesses the ability to use Promotion to gain the abilities of other Evil Pieces.

Promotion: Being a Pawn, Bülent can use Promotion to temporarily gain the traits of a Queen, Rook, Knight or Bishop.

entries.name: Mihae
entries.content:
Mihae is a young girl who most notably is always seen wearing a Kimono with a color pattern of purple, orange and pink with her black hair tied on the opposite side. She has large brown eyes.

Age 18
Personality

Mihae comes across as a quiet individual but is perhaps the most kind and well-mannered girl in Riser's Peerage, she is also shown to have a polite attitude even towards her opponents. In battle, she is mostly on the sidelines of her group but will take part in battle when ordered or needed to.
History

Not much is known about Mihae, other than at some point before the series, she was reincarnated as a devil by Riser. Demonic Power: Mihae has all the powers and abilities common to Devils, including the power to cast spells.

Enhanced Magic Power: As a Bishop, she can strengthen her magic and demonic powers.

Magic Talent: As a Bishop, Mihae possesses enhanced magical abilities, the full extent of it is unknown as she is often on stand by as others fight, which suggests that she mainly uses magic as a means of support. However, she is able to emit a powerful aura all over her body and stand her own long enough against strong opponents.

Flight: Being a Devil, Mihae can use her wings to fly.
Equipment

Bishop Piece (僧侶の駒, Sōryo no koma): Mihae was reincarnated using the Bishop Piece, which her grants enhanced magic power.

entries.name: Regulus
entries.content:
Regulus is Sairaorg Bael's Pawn, as well as the spirit residing in the Longinus; Regulus Nemea.

He is also known as the Nemean Lion. He is about four to five meters tall and has a jewel on his forehead.

In his human form, he has the appearance of a young boy with spiky dark orange hair, golden eyes, and facial markings.
Personality

Regulus is shown to be an observant fighter. He's also extremely loyal to Sairaorg, calling him "Master", and constantly tries to help him by any means necessary.
History

Regulus is one of the children of the King of Monsters, Typhon and the Mother of Dog Monsters, Echidna, the strongest among Nemean Lions, who was defeated by the original Heracles as apart of his Twelve Labors, and then was sealed by God of the Bible inside the Longinus, Regulus Nemea.[1]

After its previous wielder died, Regulus, somehow, materialized himself and killed the group of people that was responsible for his host's murder. It was also at that exact time that Regulus met Sairaorg, who managed to tame him, and then reincarnate him into a Devil worth 7 Pawn Pieces Demonic Power: As a Devil, Regulus has all the common skills and powers of one.

Immense Strength: As the son of one of the "Top 10 Strongest Beings in the World" and the Strongest Nemean Lion, Regulus has immense strength, being an opponent of the Demigod, Heracles. As an avatar of Regulus Nemea, his full strength is enough to split the Earth in half. In his lion form, he was able to easily overwhelm Rias, a powerful Devil, albeit holding back enough that she didn't retire to not interrupt his Master's match and force Issei to use a Phoenix Tear. During the Hell Disaster, Regulus demonstrated enough power to easily defeat countless artificial Devils and Grim Reapers.

Immense Durability: Regulus demonstrated great durability, as he was able to withstand Rias' Power of Destruction without any injures. Transformation: Regulus has the ability to transform to a young boy who about the same age as Issei.

Flight: Being a Devil, Regulus can use his wings to fly.

entries.content:
Azazel is the former Governor General of the Fallen Angels and Grigori. He also previously served as a Chemistry teacher at Kuoh Academy and as the advisor of the Occult Research Club, prior to sealing himself in the Isolation Barrier Field. Azazel is a tall man appearing to be in his twenties with an average build, black hair, golden bangs, and black goatee. He also possesses twelve jet-black feathered wings that grow out from his back. It is described by Vali to be a never ending black.

Age 26

During the Summit, Azazel wore a V-neck maroon long-coat with a wide, open high-collar that opens up at the hem. The long-coat also featured two black belts around the waist and four black bands on each arm, two of the bands at the wrist and the other two near the elbow. He wore grey slacks and brown shoes.

After the events in Volume 4, he loses his left arm, but replaces it with a prosthetic arm made from his Sacred Gear research.

When he served as a Chemistry teacher at Kuoh Academy, Azazel wore a knee-length dark blue blazer with a lighter blue dress shirt, a black waist coat, and a red tie. He wore faded-purple slacks and black dress shoes. Azazel's height is 188 cm (6 feet 2 inches) and body weight is [82 kg].
Personality

Azazel loves to collect things, (shown when, after Issei introduced him to video games, he collected every console) and a research fanatic, especially on Sacred Gears. He is also shown to be pacifistic, preferring to talk his way out of troubles rather than resorting to violence. He has been shown to care deeply for his fellow Fallen Angels, Shemhazai and Baraqiel.

Azazel has also been shown to be extremely charismatic, being able to endear his Fallen Angel followers. Azazel has complicated feelings about the fact that many of his friends and acquaintances are all married and have a family. Azazel is also perverted because of his fondness for breasts, and also due to the fact that he has stated to have had hundreds of harems over the millennia. Not to mention that his stated reason for becoming a Fallen Angel all those millennia ago was lust. Even before he became a Fallen Angel, he was already a pervert as he would fantasize about touching/seeing Gabriel's breasts, the most beautiful woman in Heaven as evident when he encouraged Issei to use Dress Break on her.

Azazel is also very compassionate as he would do whatever he can to help people in need. The most prominent example is when he adopted Vali and cared for him as his own son, after learning of the immense abuse and cruelty Vali suffered by his father and grandfather.

However, there seems to be a hidden former side to Azazel as Shiva told him that he is the most sinister of the Fallen Angels, despite wanting to spread peace. Azazel later lost his place in the Heaven after having sex with a human woman and became a Fallen Angel as punishment from God. Shortly after that, he created the Fallen Angels' organization, Grigori, and became its Governor General. At some point, before the series begins, Azazel found a young Vali Lucifer who had been abandoned by his parents, took him to Grigori, and taught him how to properly use his powers along with his Sacred Gear while raising him.

Azazel firing multiple light spears

He can easily generate numerous light spears and shoot them like arrows without the slightest sign of exhaustion, being able to create a gigantic light spear before turning it into several light arrows.

During the Three Factions Conference, he fought against Katerea, an Ultimate-Class Devil and a Leviathan descendant even without using his Down Fall Dragon Spear. Donned in his Dragon Armor, he fought Cao Cao, the Strongest Longinus user; and in Vol 11, Pluto, an Ultimate-Class Grim Reaper. In Vol 16, Azazel has shown incredible physical strength able to destroy the nearby wall using a single punch.

Immense Durability: Azazel has remarkable durability and pain tolerance, showing no reaction to cutting off his own left arm after freeing himself from Katerea's tentacle arms who planned on self-destructing. He later survived a surprise attack from Vali before casually emerged relatively unharmed following his betrayal. Azazel endured a light blast from Cao Cao's True Longinus with only slight burns.

Immense Speed: Azazel is capable of moving at God-like speed, being able to appear behind his opponents without them noticing. Down Fall Dragon Spear: An Artificial Sacred Gear that has one of the Five Dragon Kings, Fafnir, sealed inside of it after he made a pact with him. It has the appearance of a golden short spear which has a purple ball at its end. Down Fall Dragon Another Armor: Balance Breaker of Down Fall Dragon Spear, which equips Azazel with a Golden Dragon Armor, which he made based on Vali's Scale Mail. It increases Azazel's offensive and defensive capabilities and allows Azazel to summon a two-pronged Spear of Light. However, the armor isn't as powerful as genuine Scale Mail armor as Cao Cao noted that Azazel can't reflect Fafnir's power with it.
Blazer Shining or Darkness Blade: An Artificial Sacred Gear that takes the form of a sword with a mixture of light and darkness with high destructive powers.
Blazer Shining or Darkness Samurai Sword: An Artificial Sacred Gear that takes the form of a katana sword. Like the original, it possesses the same destructive powers as well as the ability to cut down spirits without physical forms. It was later given to Tomoe Meguri.
Blazer Shining or Darkness Blade - Kitchen Knife Type: An Artificial Sacred Gear that takes the form of an ordinary kitchen knife that releases a slight golden aura. It can basically cut almost anything including evil spirits. It is later confiscated by Grigori.

entries.name: Kokabiel
entries.content:
Kokabiel is one of the leaders of the Fallen Angels and Grigori until his betrayal. He is the main antagonist in Volume 3 of the light novels. Kokabiel has the appearance of a tall, pale man with long black hair and narrow, blood red eyes. Unlike other Fallen Angels, Kokabiel has pointy, elf-like ears. Kokabiel possesses five pairs of black wings, though one of them was ripped off by Vali when he was sent to retrieve the Fallen Angel.

100+

He wears a black robe with detailed accessories and purple shoulder pads with gold streaks on the side.
Personality

Kokabiel vehemently believes that the Fallen Angels are the strongest race and strives to prove it by any means necessary. In Volume 4, Sirzechs mentioned that Kokabiel enjoys war and bloodshed, compared to Azazel who enjoys peace and advancement. To that end, he wanted to start another Great War but faces strong objection from Azazel. As such, he has a strong hatred towards Azazel, believing that he is defiling the Fallen Angels' culture and reputation by performing Sacred Gear research and allowing humans with Sacred Gears to join Grigori. He is also shown to be highly arrogant and boasts a great deal of confidence in his power, as seen when he actually told and waited for Issei to boost his power to his limit and transfer it to Rias because that was the only way they would be able to hurt him.
History

Originally an Angel from Fifth Heaven, Kokabiel is one of the leaders of Grigori and one of the few Fallen Angels that survived the Great War. Unlike the other leaders of the Fallen Angels, Kokabiel desired to continue the war but faced strong opposition from Azazel and Shemhazai which eventually resulted in his betrayal and rebellion.

During the Second World War, Kokabiel fought against Vasco Strada, the former wielder of Durandal, and was eventually cornered by the latter. Immense Light Power: As a Fallen Angel, Kokabiel has the ability to use Light Power to create various effects. As one of the Cadre, his Light Powers are superior to that of other lower-ranked Fallen Angels.

Light-Based Weapons: Kokabiel is very proficient in using his light-based weapons, being able to create Light Swords and spears that are larger than Kuoh Academy itself. Immense Strength: As a Cadre of the Fallen Angels, Kokabiel can create weapons of light with ease, and likely wields power equivalent to a Satan-Class Devil. This was shown when Kokabiel was able to easily overwhelm the Occult Research Club alone and Azazel stated that at that time Kokabiel was so strong that Issei was incapable of defeating him, no matter how many times he boosted his power with Boosted Gear. When he fought Vali Lucifer during the latter's retrieval of him, Vali noted that his power after being divided three times by Divine Dividing is now that of a mid-class Fallen Angel, indicating that Kokabiel is eight times stronger than one.

Immense Durability: Kokabiel was able to take Rias' attack that was boosted many times by Issei's Boosted Gear with only slight burns.

Steel Feathers: He can also fire the feathers of his wings as projectiles to pierce his opponents with the feathers being as hard as steel. He is also capable of using his wings for both offense and defense, as shown when he fought the Occult Research Club.

entries.name: Baraqiel
entries.content:
Baraqiel is the current Vice Governor General of the Fallen Angels and Grigori. He is the father of Akeno Himejima and the widower of Shuri Himejima. Baraqiel is also one of Azazel's closest friends, alongside Shemhazai.

Age 47

Baraqiel has the appearance of a middle-aged, gruff-looking man with black hair, a matching beard, and a muscular body. Originally being a Cadre-class Fallen Angel, Baraqiel possesses ten black wings[1].
Personality

Baraqiel has a serious, rigid warrior-type personality. Baraqiel is very protective of his daughter, Akeno, and is initially hostile to Issei due to his misconception of him being "a Dragon that devours breasts". This also suggests that he is naive to jokes, taking them in a literal sense. He also has a masochistic side to him, the inverse of which is inherited by his daughter.
History

Originally, Baraqiel was one of the Angels from Fifth Heaven, where he became known as the Lightning of God. But, he soon became one of the first Angels that fell alongside Azazel and Shemhazai, eventually becoming one of the Leaders of Grigori, an organization that soon became one of the Three Factions. He and the others fought in the Great War against the angels and devils until the death of the God of the Bible and Four Maou in the aftermath.

In the past, Baraqiel was injured and found by Shuri Himejima who nursed him back to health leading to them falling in love with one another, leading to marriage. Their union also led to them giving birth to their only daughter, Akeno Himejima. However, the Himejima Clan couldn't accept her as a fallen angel-human hybrid. At some point, when Baraqiel was called back to Grigori by Azazel, the Himejima Clan members, led by Suou Himejima, took advantage of this to kill Shuri and Akeno, but they only managed to murder the former before Baraqiel arrived to save his daughter. However, he was rejected by her who developed a hatred for him and her fallen angel lineage, which led to her mother's death.

Powers & Abilities

Immense Light Power: As a Fallen Angel, Baraqiel has the ability to use light power to create various effects.

Light-Based Weapons: While not shown in the light novel, in the anime, Baraqiel has shown that he can create a light sword.
Holy Lightning (雷光, Raikō): Baraqiel's signature ability as a former Angel who bears the Lightning of God, one that combines light and lightning together. It is reputed to be number one among Fallen Angels in damage output in a single strike, being able to kill High-Class Devils and wound Ultimate-Class Devils in one strike, and is ten times stronger than his daughter's. Baraqiel's mastery is enough for him to create spears, creating thunder clouds to make Holy Lightning bolts rain down on his opponents, as well as infuse it into his punches and kicks, letting him fight Issei in his Crimson Armor, after it was strengthened as a side effect of his Dragon Deification, on equal terms.
Immense Strength: As a former Cadre, Baraqiel possesses great power, able to hold his own against a lower-end Satan-class powerhouse like Issei in his crimson armor, although he admitted that, even with his power enhanced by anger, he still wouldn't beat Issei in a contest of power. By possessing God`s Holy Lightning, he can kill a High-Class Devil or injure an Ultimate-Class Devil in a single strike.

Immense Durability: Baraqiel is shown to be very durable as he was able to endure several blows from Issei in his Cardinal Crimson Promotion.

Master Hand-to-Hand Combatant: Baraqiel is shown to have great skills in hand-to-hand combat, being able to hold his own against Issei. He can also combine them with his Holy Lightning to further increase the power of his physical attacks.

Master Tactician: Baraqiel has shown to be able to implement a genius strategy, as shown in Volume 22 where he lured Issei into a corner by manipulation, completely tricking him into not noticing his plan. This is further proven when trapping Issei was all but a feint for him to use "Castling", swapping places with Rossweisse so that Baraqiel's Queen; Armaros, could ambush her.

Flight: Being a Fallen Angel, Baraqiel can fly using his wings.

entries.name: Raynare
entries.content:
Raynare was an attractive young woman with violet eyes, and a curvaceous, slender body. She had long, silky black hair that reached down to her wide plumped hips and possessed two black feathered wings characteristic of her race.

Age 19

Raynare's height is 164 cm. (5'4"), according to the visual book with her data.

Her attire consisted of a short black dress with a small, light purple jacket on top, which was worn throughout most of her appearances in both the light novel and manga.

In the anime, she had a slender body with a large bust. Her initial attire (as Yuuma) was her school uniform, which consisted of a dark red jacket with the letter "P" embroidered in gold, a white undershirt, a red bow, and a green skirt with a thin white strip around the lower end.

Upon the climax of her date with Issei, she shredded her clothing and changed into her alternate (and more common) form. In the process of transforming, she grew taller, taking on a more mature appearance, and her eyes changed, taking on a darker, narrower, and more evil look. Her clothing also changed dramatically, now consisting of black, strap-like objects (resembling leather) around and under her breasts, a thong-like piece held around her hips by three thin straps, gloves that ran right up her arms with small lengths of chains hanging from them, shoulder guard-like objects on her shoulders with three large spikes sprouting from her right shoulder, and black thigh-high heeled boots.

Her voice also dropped to a lower pitch when in this form. This form is best described as a very erotic and revealing version of her disguise.
Personality

Raynare seemed like a sweet young school girl at first, but this was just a disguise to hide her true nature. Her true personality revealed that she was vicious, petty, sadistic, treacherous, vindictive, arrogant, cruel, barbaric, and very deceptive. This was most infamously shown when she successfully manipulated Issei Hyoudou's mind in order to get close to him and kill him. She also laughed cruelly at Issei, believing him to be "weak" and that it would be "a waste of her time killing him". This shows how Fallen Angels like her can manipulate the will of mere humans with ease.

She is loyal to her superiors, Azazel and Shemhazai, and would go to great lengths for them. However her loyalty may come into question as she tends to take action without their consent, believing it's for the good of all Fallen Angels.

She has often shown overconfidence and tends to look down anyone who is (in her mind) inferior to her, as well as torment and taunt them, such as when she mocks Asia's death in front of Issei out of spite and shows no remorse.

Not much was known about Raynare's history, other than the fact that she was banished from Heaven for an offense of some sort. Shortly before the series began, Raynare came into contact with Freed and Asia, who became her subordinates.

She was sent to eliminate Issei because of his Sacred Gear's dangerous potential.

Then Raynare secretly gathered and led an independent group of Fallen Angels and Exorcists who assisted her in attempting to steal Asia's Sacred Gear; Twilight Healing, believing she was better suited for its powers, and could thus better serve her leaders.
Powers & Abilities

Light Power: As a Fallen Angel, Raynare has the ability to use Light Power to create various effects. Raynare claims that, while not flashy, her light is particularly lethal to Devils for her level, enough that it wouldn't be strange for Low-class Devils to die from blows to the legs by her spears, and that even Middle-class Devils would have a hard time healing from the wounds. Issei stated that it felt like his bones and muscles were "melting," even after he removed the weapon itself.

Light-Based Weapons: Raynare could create and throw spears of light to kill Devils. However, unlike most Fallen Angels who wield only one light spear, Raynare was skilled enough to create several light spears at once. She could put enough power behind them to pierce the body of a Rook-promoted Low-class Devil such as Issei, who demonstrated enough durability to easily withstand bullets of light in that state not long before.
Magic: She is shown to be at least knowledgeable in some magic.

Memory Alteration: Raynare was also able to wipe the memories and all the records of her existence as Yuuma from all the students she has met with at Kuoh Academy.
Cloth Manipulation: She has shown to change between her casual clothing and her revealing black leather attire.[note 1]
Flight: Being a Fallen Angel, Raynare could fly using her wings.

Enhanced Durability: Raynare took a boosted blow from an enraged, Rook-promoted (albeit pre-training) Issei, and while knocked unconscious, was easily reawakened not long after seemingly without any serious injuries.

Enhanced Speed: Raynare was repeatedly able to gore Issei with her spears before he could react & at speeds he didn't notice her firing off the shot, before & after he became a devil.
Equipment

Twilight Healing (Temporary): After performing the ritual to extract Twilight Healing from Asia, Raynare gained her Sacred Gear thus allowing her to heal herself. After being defeated by Issei and killed by Rias, the Twilight Healing is retrieved by Rias and returned to Asia.

entries.name: Kalawarna
entries.content:
Kalawarna was a Fallen Angel who allied herself with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia Argento's Sacred Gear. Kalawarna was a tall and buxom woman with brown eyes and long, navy blue hair that obscured her right eye.

Age 21

Her attire consisted of a maroon, trenchcoat-like top with a wide collar, a matching miniskirt, and black heeled shoes. The trenchcoat top was open at her chest, giving view to her breasts and cleavage. She also wore a gold necklace around her neck. She appears to wear a white shirt underneath her top, but it can only be seen from the bottom.
Personality

Kalawarna was shown to be an arrogant and no-nonsense woman with a tendency to look down on her opponents. She is quite sadistic and shows no mercy towards her opponents. She also appears to be quite loyal to their leader, Azazel. She is also a cruel and manipulative cynic.
History

Not much was known about Kalawarna, other than the fact that she sided with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia's Sacred Gear.

Light-Based Weapons: Kalawarna can create and throw light spears to kill Devils.

Flight: Being a Fallen Angel, Kalawarna can fly using her wings.

entries.name: Dohnaseek
entries.content:
Dohnaseek was a Fallen Angel allied with Raynare in the latter's plot to steal Asia Argento's Sacred Gear Dohnaseek was a middle-aged-looking man with short black hair and dark blue eyes[2].

His attire consisted of a pale gray trench coat over a white dress shirt with a matching ascot, black pants and shoes, a pair of black gloves, and a black fedora.
Personality

Dohnaseek was shown to be somewhat of a battle maniac  In the anime, Dohnaseek was shown to be somewhat arrogant, looking down on both Rias and Akeno who came to confront him and his allies 
History

Not much was known about Dohnaseek, other than the fact that he sided with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia's Sacred Gear Light-Based Weapons: Dohnaseek could generate and throw light spears to kill Devils

Flight: Being a Fallen Angel, Dohnaseek could fly using his wings

Age 29

entries.name: Mittelt
entries.content:
Mittelt was a Fallen Angel who allied herself with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia Argento's Sacred Gear  Mittelt was a girl with blonde hair which was styled into twin-tails and blue eyes.

Age 13

She wore a Gothic Lolita attire, which consisted of a black dress with white frills, a large black bow on the front, and a green jewel embedded on the collar, white thigh-high socks with suspender garters, black set of frilly panties, and black shoes. She also wore a large black bow on top of her hair

Despite her intricate design, she is only mentioned in the light novel by name three times and is never present in a scene. Similar to the other two fallen angels aligned to Raynare , her introduction, role, and exit is not described at all.
Personality

Mittelt seemed to be a joyful, upbeat girl at first glance but in reality she was playfully cruel, spiteful, and cynical This is shown from the fact that she felt no hesitation on trolling her opponents. This shows when she is confronted by Rias and Akeno who proceeds to call her bratty and annoying.
History

Not much is known about Mittelt, other than the fact that she sided with Raynare in her plot to steal Asia's Sacred Gear.

Light-Based Weapons: Mittelt could create and throw light spears capable of killing devils.

Flight: Being a Fallen Angel, Mittelt could fly using her wings

entries.name: Irina shidou
entries.content:
Irina Shidou (紫藤 イリナしどう イリナ, Shidō Irina) is one of the many female protagonists of High School DxD and the childhood friend of Issei Hyoudou.

Age 18

Irina is a third-year high school student at Kuoh Academy in Class 3-B and is a devout Christian who, even after learning of God's death, still follows his teachings. She is later reincarnated as an Angel by the Archangel Michael, through one of the Brave Saints, her ranking among his peerage being "Ace Of Spades". She is also one of Issei's fiancées. Irina is a beautiful young woman with violet eyes. She has long chestnut hair that is usually tied into twintails, each held with a blue scrunchy, but on some occasions, she lets her hair down. Her body measurements are B87-W59-H89 cm [B34-W23-H35 in]; height is 164 cm (5 feet 4 inches) and body weight is 56 kg.

She wears the standard Church battle attire, same as Xenovia's with some slight differences. After transferring to Kuoh Academy and moving into the Hyoudou Residence, she starts wearing the Kuoh Academy girls' school uniform, with black short shorts under her skirt and the addition of white sneakers with blue accents.

Following her Angelization by Michael, she wears a red "A" printed on her right hand, symbolizing her position as Michael's Ace. Irina also gained white Angel wings and a halo, as of Volume 17, she has a total of 4 wings.
Personality

Irina is a cheerful, carefree, upbeat, and enthusiastic person. She is also shown to be cooperative and open-minded to others as she is seen with Arthur Pendragon discussing Excalibur Ruler, although he stated that the location is secret.

She is a fiercely devout Christian, even more so than Xenovia, showing great respect for God's teachings. During her first appearance, she was very harsh towards those whom she perceived as an opposition to her religion. This was demonstrated by how she and Xenovia treated Asia Argento when they first met, as well as her reaction to Xenovia becoming a Devil. The death of God of the Bible was a great shock for Irina, yet she still believes in his teachings and transferred her belief to Michael who is the current "God". Irina later became close friends with Asia and the rest of the Occult Research Club members, even joining the ORC herself.

As noted by Michael, in addition to her strong Christian faith, Irina is innocent, honest, respectful, and friendly, the traits which he valued and also the reason he chose her to be his Ace.

Irina began experiencing "impure thoughts" around Issei; her Angel wings start to flicker from white to black indicating that she is about to "fall" from her status as a true Angel to a Fallen Angel if she gives in to her desires. She is shown to be very sensitive to and annoyed about being called "self-proclaiming". After kissing Issei, she becomes bolder in her relationship with him, as she becomes slightly less concerned about "falling" in order to show her love for him. This has also caused her to become perverted herself, as she has no qualms by being with Issei, even desiring to have sex with him. Irina's family lineage is related to the church, and her father being a pastor and exorcist of the Protestant Church and possessing a currently unidentified Holy Sword.[1] She is Issei's childhood friend who was under the impression that she was a boy, due to appearing quite tomboyish, and they were close friends who used to play together. At some point, she kissed him while he was sleeping at her house. She later left Japan and went to England with her family, due to her father's job, where she trained to become an exorcist of the Protestant Church.

Three years prior at age 14, Irina was granted the ability to wield Holy Swords via a Holy Element and was given Excalibur Mimic, thus following in her father's footsteps. Soon after, she was eventually partnered with Xenovia, where they undertook a mission to slay the stray Vampire from the House of Manthar.

At some point in time, she crossed blades with a knight from Riser Phenex's Peerage named Karlamine 

Light Power: As an Angel, Irina has the ability to use Light Powers to create various effects.

Light-Based Weapons: As an Angel, Irina is able to create Light-based weapons such as Light Swords. In the anime, she has shown to be able to use light halos that wrapped about her foes of remarkable power and size such as one of Fenrir's sons. In Volume DX.4, Irina created a move, which creates rings of light that homes in on her opponents and radiates light. In Volume 25, she made a whip of light that imitates Excalibur Mimic.
Artificial Holy Sword Wielder: After taking in the Light Container, Irina became an artificial Holy Sword user, being able to wield Excalibur Mimic and later Hauteclere.

Enhanced Speed: While she can't match up to the likes of Yuuto Kiba, Irina is still noticeably fast due to her training as an Exorcist as she dodged Jeanne's attacks with ease.

Enhanced Luck: Due to also receiving Ophis' blessing, Irina gained improved luck, gaining second place in a lottery.

Master Swordswoman: Like Xenovia, Irina is well versed in swordsmanship, specialized in tricky movements that makes use of her speed, being able to fight on par with Jeanne during their first encounter. By Volume 19, Irina's swordsmanship skills became great enough being able to keep up against Ewald Cristaldi wielding a replica of Excalibur. Tomoe Meguri admitted that Irina's swordsmanship is on a whole different level.

entries.name: Michael
entries.content:
Michael is the former leader of the Angels and Seraphs before Gabriel took over. He is one of the God of the Bible's creations, who took his place as leader after he died in the Great War. His current goals are to recreate the lost members of Heaven (mainly the Seraphim) and guide the Church with God's teachings. Upon the implementation of the Brave Saints system, he became King of the Suit of Spades ♠.

Age 1000+

Michael has the appearance of a handsome-looking man with long blond hair and green eyes. Like Azazel, he has twelve wings growing from his back, and unlike other Angels whose wings are white, his wings are colored gold, further symbolizing his position as the former leader. He wears a red robe with a gold cross on the front of his white alb. He has golden shoulder plates with a white sash and a golden halo set above his head

In the anime, his eyes are shaped in a perpetually sad manner even when genuinely angered or happy.
Personality

As leader of the Angels, Michael in his few appearances has shown to be extremely kind and compassionate. However, he will put the good of the many above the good of the few, as shown when he allowed Asia to be banished in order to preserve the religious faith of the Christian people and not risk the safety of Heaven. Michael is extremely loyal to his creator the God of the Bible. After his death, Michael did everything he could to maintain the religion of Christianity, leading the Angels and guiding the Church. He is even willing to be allied with the Angel's former enemies of Fallen Angels and Devils to ensure the Angels survival as a species.

Despite being an Angel, Michael lacks any of the prejudice and bigotry that a lot of Angels bear towards Devils and Fallen Angels due to his immense kindness, and is perfectly willing to show kindness to or even befriend them. This is shown in his first interaction with Issei, where he showed courtesy and politeness.

Despite his kindness, Michael can be merciless towards evil people like Rizevim as shown when Michael outright stated to Rizevim he will show no mercy.
History

One of the first creation and right-hand man of the Biblical God, Michael served as the leader of the Angels and assisted the Biblical God in the Great War against the Devils and Fallen Angels. After God died in the Great War, the Angels were forced to retreat as Michael and the other Seraphs try to activate the Heavens' system and were successful in activating it with Michael as the center as he takes over the place of his Creator as the supervisor of the Heavens' system.
Powers & Abilities

Immense Light Power: As a Angel, Michael has the ability to use light to create various effects. As one of the Four Great Seraph, more so the Archangel, his light powers are superior to that of others, even among the Seraph.

Light-Based Weapons: Being an Angel, Michael is able to form various weapons and attacks from light. Michael's ability in creating and using weapons of light is vastly superior to regular Angels, able to quickly create a gigantic spear of light as shown when he attacked Rizevim.
Immense Strength: As the former leader of the Seraphs and Angels, and the only Archangel along with being the only Angel with twelve golden wings, Michael is the strongest Angel and likely wields power equivalent to a Satan-Class Devil.

Master Magician: Michael has expert knowledge when it comes to various kind of magic spells common to those of holy and angelic magics and rune symbols.

Defensive Magic: Michael can create very powerful barriers that protect Team DxD from his own light attacks directed at Rizevim. Flight: Being an Angel, Michael can use his twelve golden wings to fly.
Equipment

Holy System: Michael's true power, however, comes from the fact that he is now the one in control of the system created by God in the distant past, which is what causes harm to Devils who come into contact with blessed objects, provides miracles, and determines who can be saved. Unfortunately, with Michael in charge, the system is vastly inferior to how it was with God running it. However, since entering the Isolation Barrier Field, this was transferred over to Gabriel.

entries.name: Ophis
entries.content:
Age “unknown” Ophis is the Dragon God who represents Infinity, Chaos, and Nothingness, known as the Ouroboros Dragon and the Infinite Dragon God. She is one of the most powerful Dragons and beings in existence, aside from Great Red. Ophis was the Khaos Brigade's figurehead, before the betrayal of the Hero Faction, where she lost a portion of her power because of Samael, which would later birth Lilith.[1] Afterwards, she started living inside of the Hyoudou Residence with the others as the group's friend and supporter. Ophis' current appearance is that of a cute young girl with long black hair down to her hips and black eyes (gray in the anime). Her ears differ from a normal human's as they have pointed tips, although her long black hair makes this feature difficult to notice. Her dark grey eyes have reptilian slitted pupils. Azazel stated that Ophis had the appearance of an old man in the past before changing it. Her body measurements are [B66-W53-H70]; height is [137 cm] and body weight is [31 kg].

Her attire consists of a black Gothic Lolita fashion.

However, Ophis is a true shapeshifter, able to freely manipulate her body shape and size to assume any form that she chooses, regardless of her age, race, or gender. Unlike the other Dragons that have large reptilian-like bodies, Ophis is a humanoid-shaped Dragon.[2]
Personality

Born from nothingness, Ophis has little-to-no emotions, to the point of being viewed as apathetic. Her sole desire was to return to the Dimensional Gap, and reobtain "silence" through getting rid of Great Red, who she has shown the most, if the slightest aggression towards. Outside of that, Ophis doesn't care about the people or things around her; helping the Khaos Brigade as long as they helped her. Despite her superior powers, Ophis never boasts about it; however, Ophis didn't kill Cao Cao despite his betrayal, because she could kill him whenever she wanted.

Over time, Azazel indicated that Ophis changed due to spending time around and interacting with the Human World, which later started being shown. Issei himself stated that she was a pure and honest dragon, her powers caused people to fear her and tricked into leading the Khaos Brigade.[3] After befriending Issei, she abandoned the Khaos Brigade and her original goals.

Her deep naiveté caused her to act childish, often mimicking the actions that catches her attention and often wanders off to anything she finds interesting. Ophis is also honest, while coming off as rude, to the point of being brutal without being aware about it; as noted when she described Koneko as "Cat" and Ravel as "Bird".[4] Another time was when she had commented she was stronger than Michael, after Irina questioned whether or not it was fine to pray to her.[5] Whenever she is asked a question she seems to take interest in, she goes into "? Mode" which is where she goes into deep thought about the question asked. Ophis loves eating sweets (a trait passed down to Lilith) as well as bananas.
History

Sometime in the distant past, Ophis was born in the Dimensional Gap and lived there as its home. Eventually, long ago, Ophis left the Gap, but when she attempted to return, she found that the Great Red had taken up residence there. Before assuming her current form, she used a different guise in the form of an elderly man. At some point before the start of the series, Ophis became the leader of the Khaos Brigade.
Powers & Abilities

Immense Strength: As a Dragon God, Ophis is the strongest being in the world not counting Great Red,[6] exceeding the Heavenly Dragons in their prime combined, with Ddraig stating her power is infinite. In fact, despite losing a large portion of her power due to Samael and becoming “finite”, it was stated that she was still twice as strong as Ddraig and Albion, with her stating that she felt "weak" despite that level of power. Since losing her original strength, her powers became unstable, releasing destructive power that had annihilated everything. A normal slap from Ophis can cause destructive results, sending a yeti flying and causing Nurarihyon great pain after slapping his butt. Ophis in her prime would be equivalent to the likes of Great Red and Trihexa. It is stated that if Ophis and Lilith fight together, they can access all of Ophis' former power; with their power being infinite.[7]

Immense Durability: Being an existence with the power of infinity, Ophis' durability borders on the point of near absolute invulnerability as shown when Ophis was stabbed by the True Longinus, an immensely powerful Sacred Gear capable of slaying Gods, and was completely unaffected when Issei stated that Ophis did not even shed blood.
